openwrt_wiki.einleitung: The AP1300 (Cirrus) is a wireless access point with two Ethernet ports. The WAN port has 802.1af PoE, and there are addons for bluetooth or cellphone radios. It ships with Chaos Calmer [15.05], and is designed exclusively for OpenWrt. It comes with two versions, GL-AP1300LTE is a 4G LTE router with a CAT4 or CAT6 modem, and GL-AP1300 is the standard version. Both of them have built-in PoE and watchdog features.
openwrt_wiki.hinweis_hardware: Note: Only GL-AP1300LTE version has a 4G LTE built-in modem
openwrt_wiki.installation: Per commit b9389186b012e5bd99ea the firmware is installed from uboot TFTP by holding the reset button, connecting power, and waiting until the power led flashes 5 times, and then turns solid. First the factory image is loaded from uboot tftp or web after which the sysupgrade image can be used.
